build_command: pandoc SHELL_CONTACT.md --from markdown+tex_math_single_backslash --standalone --include-in-header preamble.tex -V geometry:margin=0.9in -V fontsize=10pt -V colorlinks=true --output SHELL_CONTACT.tex; pdflatex twice
build_location: Use a scratch copy of the complete capsule so ../figures resolves. Do not rebuild inside the frozen original.
pdf_reproducibility: PDF metadata timestamps may differ on rebuild; the reviewed PDF bytes are pinned.
scope: Technical draft for author review, no new APS submission.
